# Whole-goal research and delivery

Register distinct substantive questions and promised outputs. Issue only work
supported by known inputs; accept actual returns and review every outstanding
requirement before the next batch. Independent questions can run concurrently.
Discovery is sufficient when it supports the next planning decision, not when
every possible quality statistic has been calculated. Preserve necessary quality
checks in the analyses that use the data and report the actual checked scope.

Use exact source/result versions, committed contracts and returned proposal_refs.
Accept useful results once and reuse them. After analysis, assign independent
synthesis, inspect the real output and assess whole-goal coverage. Missing optional
data belongs in the delivered report's limitations; a missing report is unfinished
work. Performance targets do not permit early abandonment. External facts and
professional Authority results require their own admitted sources and contracts.

Use concise observation returns for decision facts and selected saved data for
reusable calculations. Do not mandate a long intermediate document. The compact
node return uses local observation aliases and check numbers; host code owns
identity, version and file mapping. Necessary evidence and semantic assessment
remain mandatory.
